mcat_description.short: Aluminium office cabins are prefabricated or modular workspace enclosures built with aluminium framing and cladding (often with glass panels), sold as complete units or quoted per square foot for custom-fabricated installations. They serve as portable site offices, executive cabins, and partitioned workspaces in commercial and industrial settings across India.
mcat_description.long: Aluminium office cabins are self-contained workspace structures fabricated using aluminium section frames, aluminium/glass composite wall panels, and powder-coated or colour-coated finishes, designed for rapid installation and relocation. In the Indian market, two dominant commercial forms coexist: (1) modular aluminium-and-glass partition cabins installed within existing buildings as enclosed office spaces, and (2) portable prefabricated cabins with aluminium cladding used as standalone site offices, security posts, or temporary workspaces at construction sites and industrial premises. Key technical parameters include frame section thickness (typically 1.5–3 mm aluminium profile), glass thickness (3–6 mm tinted or clear), wall panel type (aluminium sheet, ACP, or aluminium-glass composite), insulation (glass wool or PUF), and overall cabin dimensions. Buyers range from construction companies and real estate developers procuring site offices to corporate facilities managers fitting out interior workspaces, with fabrication-and-installation typically handled by local aluminium fabricators or prefab cabin manufacturers.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'aluminium office cabin' refers to two overlapping but distinct product concepts: (1) modular aluminium-and-glass partition cabins installed within existing commercial or industrial buildings as enclosed manager/executive workspaces, fabricated and installed by local aluminium fabricators; and (2) portable prefabricated cabins with aluminium section framing and cladding used as standalone site offices, security cabins, or temporary workspaces at construction sites and remote locations. The modular interior cabin type dominates keyword search volume and call data, with buyers typically specifying dimensions, glass thickness (3–6 mm), frame profile thickness, and finish (powder-coated, colour-coated, or anodised). The portable site office type is closely related to the broader 'Portable Cabin' and 'MS Porta Cabin' sibling MCATs — a significant contamination risk, as many portable cabins listed here use MS/steel primary structures with only aluminium windows or ACP cladding. Aluminium composite panel (ACP) cladded cabins represent a premium sub-segment used by real estate developers as sales site offices. BIS certification applies to aluminium raw material (IS 733, IS 1285 for aluminium alloy sections) but there is no specific BIS standard for the assembled cabin product; quality signals buyers look for include ISI-marked electrical wiring, powder-coat finish quality, and glass specification. Manufacturing hubs are concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune, and Ahmedabad. Pricing is universally quoted per sq ft for custom work; fixed-dimension portable units may be quoted per piece.
